summary: @DeahHegedus wants us to take risks moving programs fully online. When I got here had to beg to teach an online. Was allowed hybrid. People thought you can't teach literacy in online learning. I then got a grant to work on digital teaching and learning MA degree. Proposal just sat going nowhere.
author: Greg McVerry
body_html: @DeahHegedus wants us to take risks moving programs fully online. When I got here had to beg to teach an online. Was allowed hybrid. People thought you can't teach literacy in online learning. I then got a grant to work on digital teaching and learning MA degree. Proposal just sat going nowhere.
